name: @hyperbolic/brain
description: The Brain daemon (07-brain-architecture.md): one long-lived autonomous-coding orchestrator. m4-08 ships the daemon lifecycle, SQLite WAL state store, DAG scheduler, and crash recovery. m4-09 adds the brain.task.v1/brain.result.v1 contract schemas, the skeleton planner, and journaled run submission; real harness adapters (m4-10) and the CLI/API/UI surfaces (m4-13/14/15) land in later issues.
